The Hudson River flows through the eastern part of New York State.

notes: Model pilot (haiku arm; the same pole is tested independently by the other arm, pairing disclosed): this pole reads the held pole bonsai1/L11/N10296+ (zeroing the anchor removes 1.00 of this pole's activation), from a batched edge measurement with 8 same-layer placebos. Label and all 16 sentences written by the Haiku 5.5 labeller from a packet (card + all-pole band samples + the edge hint) and one probe round of 8 sentences (none reused). An Opus gate checked rule-level items only and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Probes: York fired at 0.62 inside New York, Albany only 0.27 and 0.06, and Square and Canal were weak. The quiet near misses that name other states stayed below 0.3 except Erie Canal in Ohio at 0.22, so the York token, not the wider topic, carries the pole. Confidence is medium because the probes had only four sentences.
